notes: VCA303 rework: dropped the page-wide 'CARRY OVER' watermark; instead each carry-over point (where a buyer's card continues to the next column) now prints a darker 'Carry Over' stamp just above the 'தொடர்கிறது →' cue — only where a continuation actually occurs. Every continued chunk now starts fresh at the top of its own column (opening rows never split into a small remainder). VCA304: the Cash Book no longer shows a false 'unsaved changes' prompt after the day is closed or when a saved grid is merely reopened for edit — the leave-prompt now fires only on real unsaved amounts and never once the day is closed; the dialog is reworded ('Unsaved amounts on this screen … only those unsaved amounts are discarded — anything you've already saved stays safe').
